warning: Red outlines are refuge parts of KDWP wildlife areas and Corps lakes whose own regulation text closes them to hunting or access; amber ones are refuges or special-permit areas with conditions. Dates differ by area and are quoted from KDWP’s hunting map. Non-toxic shot is required on some areas, and nonresidents must stop hunting by noon and leave KDWP lands by 1:00 p.m. Not being listed does NOT make a place open.
source: KDWP hunting map (Refuge, State Wildlife Refuges layers); K.A.R. 115-8; KDWP 2026–27 hunting regulations.
